purpose: Build a deterministic, versioned identity-only bridge artifact from the D3 seam logic without reading outcomes, signals, prices, or the sealed end-test window and without carrying a derived series silently across a seam.
accessOrder: freeze this preregistration in a dedicated commit before reading the D3 result artifact, D3 report, panel rows, or identity evidence
inspect the committed D3 implementation and the panel schema without executing an empirical calculation
implement the bridge builder and seam-aware derived-series contract
deliberately enable an unmarked cross-seam calculation and require the seam guard to fail red
restore the guard and rerun the synthetic fixture self-test green
build the bridge only from allowed identity evidence and validate all invariants
build the same artifact a second time from the same inputs and require the canonical SHA-256 hash to match
write an identity-free result artifact and render the report only from that artifact
allowedIdentityEvidence: normalized company name attached to the panel identity record
internal CIK attached to the panel identity record
exchange or listing venue attached to the panel identity record
explicit rename records or identifier-change records available before any outcome is observed
D3's pre-existing pure identifier-change classification, but not D3 recovery outcomes or rates
forbiddenInputs: signal values or signal-arm membership as linkage evidence
prices, returns, ranks, or forward windows
growth, acceleration, revenue-value similarity, or any other numeric-series agreement
post-linkage retention or attrition results as linkage evidence

bridgeRule.entityKey: A versioned pseudonymous entity key is derived deterministically from the internal CIK namespace; raw company names and raw CIK values are not written to result artifacts.
bridgeRule.eligibleLink: Two identifiers may share an entity only when internal CIK equality is present and the remaining available identity evidence is non-contradictory: exact normalized-name continuity, an explicit rename chain, or exchange continuity. Any conflicting CIK, conflicting exchange without an explicit transfer record, or ambiguous one-to-many evidence fails closed.
bridgeRule.identifierScope: The bridge records identifier membership and seam locations. It does not concatenate numeric observations or assert economic comparability across identifiers.
bridgeRule.ordering: Canonical records are sorted by pseudonymous entity key, seam time, old identifier, and new identifier before hashing.
bridgeRule.duplicatePolicy: Exact duplicate evidence collapses deterministically; conflicting or ambiguous duplicates are invariant violations and are never resolved from empirical results.

seamContract.default: Every derived series terminates at its first bridge seam.
seamContract.explicitCrossSeamMode: A caller may cross a seam only by declaring crossSeam=true and receiving an output marker that names the seam policy and the crossed-seam count.
seamContract.forbiddenBehavior: A derived series that contains observations on both sides of a seam while lacking the explicit cross-seam marker is a hard failure.
seamContract.requiredSabotage: A deliberate fixture mutation that removes the marker from a cross-seam calculation must make the self-test exit non-zero before completion is claimed.

testStatistic.primary: count of bridge-contract violations: invalid identity links, ambiguous mappings, unmarked cross-seam derived series, forbidden-input accesses, and canonical rerun hash mismatches
secondary: number of explicitly marked cross-seam fixture calculations
testStatistic.effectiveN: identity-evidence links and seams; no company outcome, signal observation, price observation, or quarterly value is an observation for this task

nullModel: The artifact is not reproducibly safe: at least one contract violation exists or identical canonical inputs can produce a different artifact hash.
threshold: Zero contract violations and exact SHA-256 equality across two independent builds are required. One violation or one hash mismatch fails closed. Link count and seam count have no minimum success threshold and are descriptive only.
requiredInvariants: no linkage decision reads or depends on an outcome, signal, price, growth, acceleration, rank, or retention result
no row dated in 2021-2023 is opened, counted, or rendered
each old identifier maps to at most one pseudonymous entity within an artifact version
each seam has exactly one old identifier, one new identifier, and an auditable identity-evidence class
every derived series either stops at the seam or carries the explicit cross-seam marker
the deliberate unmarked cross-seam sabotage exits red
same canonical input produces the same canonical artifact SHA-256
the result artifact and report contain no raw company name, ticker, CIK, accession number, or other reversible company identity
the sealed script scripts/studie-e4d-kadenz.py remains byte-identical
roundingPolicy: Integer counts are exact. Percentages, if any are needed for artifact integrity reporting, are rounded to one decimal place; hashes are printed in full.
explicitNonClaims: This artifact does not reopen, alter, or reinterpret the completed confirmatory verdict.
An identity link does not prove that numeric values on opposite sides of a seam are economically comparable.
The artifact does not test the old hypothesis and cannot be used as evidence for it.
No descriptive attrition or survival result is produced in task R2-A1.
Installing this substrate does not authorize a new preregistered study or a method promotion.
